description: Wait (instead of sleeping) until a condition holds, polling accessibility: window / window_gone (title substring, app), text / text_gone (in app's window), element (element_index + predicate exists|gone|enabled|focused|value_equals|value_contains, value), menu / menu_closed, sheet / sheet_gone (sheet, alert or dialog), app_running / app_gone, notification (a new one, optional app / text; refused under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1). For window_gone, text_gone, menu_closed and sheet_gone the app must be running when the wait starts (a misspelled or non-running app fails immediately with app_not_found). timeout_ms default 10000, max 30000; on timeout returns what it last saw.
name: mac_wait
